summary: Parabolic Technologies filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, disclosing a November 4 underwriting agreement with Aegis Capital for a $13.5 million public offering of 4,963,235 units at $2.72 per unit, each unit comprising one Class A share (or pre-funded warrant) plus two warrants. Warrants carry a $6.80 exercise price (250% of the unit price) and expire five years after issuance. Net proceeds were approximately $5.512 million after underwriting discounts and expenses. The offering also covers warrant shares and an over-allotment option. This is a routine equity capital raise, not a special situation.
